description_en: Suspends outbound calls using data from a file
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot suspend-call-with-file --instance-id a4274627-265f-4e14-b2d6-4ee7d4f8593e --group-id 0197261b-30e6-467b-83d6-7f72af868b03 --file-path xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SuspendCallWithFile

parameters.description_en:
File path. Required.

> Get the value for this parameter by calling the GetJobDataUploadParams operation. Use the Folder value returned in the response as the FilePath value.
